evidence: Matches 'Tests' label and modifies test assets src/test/data/script_tests.json and test/functional/feature_taproot.py.
rationale: Adds test coverage for an uncovered 1,000-item stack size boundary during P2SH script execution. While Bitcoin Core is not buggy, the PR closes a gap where 'non-compliant Bitcoin implementations that check redeemScript hashes directly without executing the scriptPubKey against the stack can pass all existing test vectors' and enables QA asset updates.
